domain(person,[hunter,ictiobus]).

% Hunter uses bait or knows ictiobus.
axiom(s1, or(uses_bait(hunter), knows_ictiobus(hunter))).

% Hunter is not skilled.
axiom(s2, not(skilled(hunter))).

% If Hunter can read the water, then he is either skilled or experienced, but not both.
axiom(s3, rule([reads_water(hunter)], xor(skilled(hunter), experienced(hunter)))).

% Hunter does not understand currents.
axiom(s4, not(understands_currents(hunter))).

% If Hunter knows ictiobus, then he either reads the water or understands currents, but not both.
axiom(s5, rule([knows_ictiobus(hunter)], xor(reads_water(hunter), understands_currents(hunter)))).

% Hunter either catches fish or is successful.
axiom(s6, or(catches_fish(hunter), successful(hunter))).

% Hunter travels rivers or knows ictiobus.
axiom(s7, or(travels_rivers(hunter), knows_ictiobus(hunter))).

% Hunter knows the river.
axiom(s8, knows_river(hunter)).

% Every fisherman is either successful or unsuccessful, but not both.
axiom(s9, rule([fisherman(X)], xor(successful(X), unsuccessful(X)))).

% If Hunter is patient, then he is either adventurous or can read the water, but not both.
axiom(s10, rule([patient(hunter)], xor(adventurous(hunter), reads_water(hunter)))).

% Hunter does not use bait.
axiom(s11, not(uses_bait(hunter))).

% If Hunter knows the river, then he either has experience or catches fish, but not both.
axiom(s12, rule([knows_river(hunter)], xor(experienced(hunter), catches_fish(hunter)))).
